# Adyen Online Payments

Adyen online-payment integrations pair client-side libraries with a selected server-side Checkout API flow. The captured 2026-09-15 selection guide recommends Sessions as the default for most integrations and distinguishes one-request Sessions, two-or-three-request Sessions with additional methods, and three-request Advanced flows; exact supported-use-case and redirect/action ownership comparisons remain in the source. This dated documentation snapshot does not prove current eligibility, payment-method availability, execution, authorization, capture, or settlement.
